content.text: {"utterance": "Mara, I can answer the same-day removal question from the build side. If the kiosk reads from one approved-excerpts list, removing an item is a single edit I can do quickly, but only when someone with authority tells me. I'd propose you as the one who authorizes removal, since you log approvals, and I act on your instruction. That is a proposal, not something Theo has agreed. Failure mode: if I'm unavailable, a withdrawn excerpt stays up, so we need a backup person who can edit the list or switch the kiosk off. Nothing is built or tested. Theo, who is the backup?", "cites": ["J1"], "memory": "Jonas proposes Mara authorizes removals and he executes from a single approved list; needs a backup editor or kiosk off-switch. Asked Theo to name a backup. Retrieval-only; nothing built or tested; payment and turnaround undecided."}
